name: Kirkland Signature Rotisserie Chicken Enchilada Bake
whyItWorks: Layered corn tortillas, tender pulled rotisserie chicken, mild red enchilada sauce, and melted Monterey Jack/cheddar cheese. Soft corn tortillas and chicken are low-residue, but melted cheese and tomato spices place it in the remission tier.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until bubbling. Remove outer heavy melted cheese crust if fat-sensitive. Best paired with side steamed white rice.
